payload.reason: The evidence provides specific improvement margins for the Zero-Shot Adaptive Transfer method in slot tagging, indicating significant performance gains over existing models.

claims.text: The Zero-Shot Adaptive Transfer method shows an improvement of 7.24% in absolute F1-score with 2000 training instances.
With only 500 training instances, the method achieves an improvement of 14.57% in absolute F1-score.
ZAT shows an improvement of 14.67 in absolute F1-score over CRF when training with 500 instances.
ZAT outperforms non-adapted models by a large margin, indicating significant improvements across various training sizes.
